'''1999 Ryloth Regionals EPP Overdrive''' was a Star Wars CCG epp overdrive held in De Werft, Kaatsheuvel, Netherlands on 11 September 1999. It is known from Koen Meijssen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d161">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-08-ryloth-regional-kaatsheuvel-11-9-1999d161/ ryloth-regional-kaatsheuvel-11-9-1999], DeckTech (Koen "Mr. Pink" Meijssen, 8 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-08-ryloth-regional-kaatsheuvel-11-9-1999d161/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[1999 Ryloth Regionals]].

* '''Date:''' 11 September 1999
* '''Site:''' De Werft, Kaatsheuvel, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[EPP Overdrive]]
